name: Journal
source:
A small team of scientists have discovered a world between reality, and the one that exists within our minds. Whenever you forget a dream, whenever you lose a train of thought, that world is where everything that has left our minds dies. Recently though, and old scientist called Chrys and his apprentice Alexandria have made a breakthrough, and managed to pull a journal from this world. Now, Chrys sits down to read through this journal, discovering what life was like for the lonely wanderer in this strange world.

[From [url=https://rngkatt.itch.io/journal]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一支小型科學家團隊，發現了現實與心靈世界之間的另一個世界。每當你忘記一個夢，每當思緒中斷，那些離開頭腦的事物，便會在那裡消亡。最近，年邁的科學家Chrys與學徒Alexandria取得了突破，成功從這個世界取回一本日記。如今，Chrys坐下來翻閱它，試圖瞭解一位孤獨的流浪者，在這個奇異世界裡過著怎樣的生活。

[摘自[url=https://rngkatt.itch.io/journal]itch.io[/url]]
